title: I Never Wrote the Rules Down
style: Late-2010s adult contemporary with a punchy punk-rock groove, female lead vocal with conversational verses and a big melodic chorus. Tight live-kit drums with brisk snare, melodic electric bass, bright crunchy rhythm guitars, and restrained piano accents. Keep verses close and candid, lift into wide harmonies and fuller guitars for the chorus, then strip back for a reflective bridge before a concise final chorus. Polished modern production with energetic dynamics and clear vocal focus.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned the shape of yes by what I turned away
No borrowed spark, no stranger for a day
Let me know your laugh, your stubborn little tells
Start with something true before we cross that line ourselves

[Pre-Chorus]
A hand held out, a door left wide
No need to name what grows inside

[Chorus]
I never wrote the rules down
Still I know them by heart
Come close because you know me
Not because we need a start
You can stay right here beside me
But don’t build a life for two
I’ll meet you eye to eye, love
I won’t answer to you

[Verse 2]
A friend can be a lover, still a friend the next day
No hidden staircase leading somewhere I must stay
I’m tender when I’m with you, I mean every word
But I won’t wear a promise just because it went unheard

[Pre-Chorus]
If hope turns into something owed
I’ll say it plain before it grows

[Chorus]
I never wrote the rules down
Still I know them by heart
Come close because you know me
Not because we need a start
You can stay right here beside me
But don’t build a life for two
I’ll meet you eye to eye, love
I won’t answer to you

[Bridge]
Keep the title, keep the ladder
I won’t climb beneath your name
Call me equal, call me chosen
I’m not here to play that game
There’s room for care without a keeper
Room for closeness without claim

[Final Chorus]
I never wrote the rules down
Still they hold me where I stand
Come close because you know me
Take my heart, not my command
You can stay right here beside me
As your own and as my own
I’ll meet you eye to eye, love
That’s the only way I know

[Outro]
No fine print, no borrowed crown
I never wrote the rules down
